description: Guides informal AI coaching conversations with Loxihart colleagues — from first questions to skeptic conversations to helping power users go deeper. Activates when a colleague asks about AI tools, when someone is skeptical about AI at work, when a teammate needs help getting started with Claude, when someone is stuck on a specific AI task, when a peer asks if AI is appropriate for their work tasks, when someone expresses concern about AI replacing jobs, when facilitating one-on-one AI onboarding, or when helping a coworker get a better result from a prompt. Also triggers on: colleague asking about Claude, show someone AI, help coworker with AI, AI skeptic, explain AI to teammate, coworker AI question, peer AI coaching, informal AI training, one-on-one AI session, AI adoption conversation, someone wants to learn AI, colleague frustrated with AI.
